title: The Art of Banarasi Weaving — 15 Centuries of Brocade
excerpt: Discover the ancient tradition of Banarasi brocade weaving — from the pit looms of Varanasi to the hands of master craftsmen who have kept this art alive for over fifteen centuries.

title: Tussar vs Kosa Silk — Understanding India's Wild Silks
excerpt: Both are wild silks, both have a natural golden lustre — but Tussar and Kosa silk are very different in texture, origin, and character. Here's how to tell them apart.

title: The Weavers of Bishnupur — Keepers of the Baluchari Tradition
excerpt: In the ancient temple town of Bishnupur, a community of weavers keeps alive the tradition of depicting Puranic narratives in silk. Meet the families behind Amayaa's Baluchari collection.

title: How to Store and Care for Your Silk Sarees
excerpt: A silk saree can last generations if cared for properly. From storage in muslin cloth to the right way to iron — our complete guide to preserving your handloom treasures.

title: Kanjivaram vs Mysore Silk — A Weaver's Perspective
excerpt: Both come from Karnataka and both are celebrated silks — but a Kanjivaram and a Mysore silk are woven very differently and suit very different occasions. A master weaver explains.

title: How to Drape a Saree — 6 Regional Styles Explained
excerpt: From the Nivi style of Andhra Pradesh to the Gujarati seedha pallu — India has over 80 ways to drape a saree. We explore six regional styles and when to wear them.
